evidence: Start: What happened? - the impact window opens with a power event in one datacenter of one zone at 18:40 UTC, 26 December. End: What happened? - that window closes at 19:30 UTC on 27 December, when mitigation was also declared. Regions: What happened? and Azure Synapse - power loss in physical zone AZ03 of South Central US; Synapse Spark failures also reached East US 2 and Brazil South.
notes: Publication date is the unlabeled date at the top of the page; it equals the incident start date. Root event was zonal (physical zone AZ03, the region's other zones serving multi-zone workloads), but Synapse impact named in two further regions, so coded multi_region. Zone given as the report's physical zone label AZ03. Cosmos DB entry runs to 03:59 UTC on 28 December, beyond the stated window; timeline also gives 13:00 UTC on 27 December for mitigation of most affected services. services_n counts 17 named Azure services (Event Hubs and Service Bus counted separately); an unnamed subset of Microsoft 365 services is not counted.

evidence: Start: What happened? and timeline - portal load failures began at 19:43 UTC after traffic was moved back through Front Door. End: What happened? and timeline - impact window closes 23:59 UTC once a second hosting domain was recovered and mitigation confirmed. Regions: title - says multiple regions but names none.
notes: Publication date is the unlabeled date at the top of the page; it equals the incident date. Title says multiple regions without naming them; the regions named (Africa, Europe, Asia Pacific, Middle East) belong to the earlier incident QNBQ-5W8, so regions left empty. Azure Portal itself was mitigated at 21:30 UTC; residual impact on other portals lasted to 23:59 UTC. services_n counts Azure Portal; other Microsoft management portals are not named individually.

evidence: Start: What happened? and timeline - GPT-5.2 requests began failing with 400 and 429 errors at 23:20 UTC on 9 March after an update. End: timeline - at 19:32 UTC on 10 March monitoring confirmed full restoration and all impact mitigated. Regions: What happened? - seven named regions across Australia, US, Korea, Norway, Sweden and UK.
notes: Publication date is the unlabeled date at the top of the page; it equals the incident start date. Only the GPT-5.2 model of Azure OpenAI Service was affected; counted as one service.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report - incident start given as 04:50 Pacific on 9 December 2022. End: Mini Incident Report - incident end given as 07:55 Pacific, a little over three hours later. Regions: Mini Incident Report Regions/Zones - eleven Asia Pacific regions plus the asia multi-region.
notes: Publication date is the posting date of the Mini Incident Report (9 Dec 2022 15:08 PST). Times converted from PST (UTC-8). The asia multi-region is also named and not coded as a region. Description gives 3 hours 17 minutes of IAM unavailability, against the stated 3 hours 5 minutes duration. services_n counts Artifact Registry, Cloud Composer, Cloud Storage and GKE; IAM is stated as not directly affected; header tag Cloud Developer Tools not counted separately.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report - log ingestion delays started at 03:19 Pacific on 14 December 2022. End: Mini Incident Report - incident end given as 06:30 Pacific after the bad sink was removed and backlog drained. Regions: Mini Incident Report Regions/Zones - only europe-west3 (Frankfurt).
notes: Publication date is the posting date of the Mini Incident Report (14 Dec 2022 12:20 PST). Times converted from PST (UTC-8). The resolution update gives 06:28 Pacific, two minutes before the stated end. Delayed logs are the impact itself, so the backlog clearing is inside the event. services_n counts the five listed services (Cloud Logging, Eventarc, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Pub/Sub); header also tags App Engine and Operations, not counted.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report - Cloud Run latency and deploy failures began 16:40 Pacific on 1 April 2023. End: Mini Incident Report and resolution update - impact over at 19:25 Pacific, resolved for all users. Regions: Mini Incident Report - location given as Global; page lists 36 previously affected regions.
notes: Publication date is the posting date of the Mini Incident Report (3 Apr 2023 11:30 PDT). Times converted from PDT (UTC-7). Regions are the 36 regions in the page's previously affected locations list.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report - gcloud CLI errors for service account users began 14:45 Pacific on 2 May 2023. End: Mini Incident Report and resolution update - impact ended 17:19 Pacific after the config rollback. Regions: Mini Incident Report - location given as Global; page lists 37 previously affected regions.
notes: Publication date is the posting date of the Mini Incident Report (4 May 2023 13:26 PDT). Times converted from PDT (UTC-7). Regions are the 37 regions in the page's previously affected locations list. services_n counts Google Cloud CLI plus the 11 products named in the status updates (Cloud Data Fusion, Memorystore, Spanner, Workflows, Dataplex, Eventarc, Dataproc, Cloud Deploy, Compute Engine, GKE, Media CDN); the Mini Incident Report itself lists only Google Cloud CLI, and the header tag Google Cloud Console is not counted.

evidence: Start: Detailed Description of Impact - load job errors ran from 14:00 Pacific on 16 October 2023. End: Detailed Description of Impact and resolution update - errors stopped at 19:00 Pacific when the rollback finished. Regions: Remediation and Mini Incident Report - impact confined to US multi-region, asia-southeast1 and azure-eastus2.
notes: Publication date is the posting date of the full Incident Report (23 Oct 2023 09:28 PDT); a Mini Incident Report was posted 17 Oct 2023. Times converted from PDT (UTC-7). The US multi-region is not a region and is not coded. azure-eastus2 is coded as Google's own BigQuery location code (BigQuery Omni on Azure East US 2). The page's previously affected locations list is far broader (all regions plus eu and us multi-regions) but the report limits impact to three locations. Mitigation completed earlier in asia-southeast1 and azure-eastus2 (by the 18:35 Pacific update) than in the US multi-region.

evidence: Start: Incident Report Summary - permission denied errors for Firebase users began 12:00 Pacific on 15 November 2023. End: Incident Report Summary and Remediation - services restored at 18:41 Pacific the same day. Regions: Detailed Description of Impact and page list - Firestore token failures worldwide, worst in nam5; location list includes Global.
notes: Publication date is the posting date of the full Incident Report (21 Nov 2023 14:33 PST); a Mini Incident Report was posted 16 Nov 2023. Times converted from PST (UTC-8). Mini Incident Report and resolution update give 18:42 Pacific and 6 hours 42 minutes; Incident Report gives 18:41 and 6 hours 41 minutes. The Incident Report says the IAM cutover began 10:00 Pacific on 13 November 2023 with growing authentication issues, but gives no customer impact start for that period. Scope global because the page lists Global and Firestore failures are described as global, although the Mini Incident Report confines impact to the nam5 multi-region. Regions are the page's listed regions plus us-central1 (named for Cloud Storage for Firebase 403s); multi-regions nam5 and eur3 and the location Global are not coded. services_n counts Firebase Authentication, Identity Platform, Firebase Security Rules, Cloud Storage for Firebase, Cloud Firestore and Cloud IAM.

evidence: Start: Mini Incident Report - slow and failing new producer instance launches began 22:29 Pacific on 20 November 2023. End: Mini Incident Report Description - service recovered 03:07 Pacific once request volume normalized. Regions: Mini Incident Report - location given as Global; page lists 39 previously affected regions.
notes: Publication date is the posting date of the Mini Incident Report (22 Nov 2023 09:59 PST). Times converted from PST (UTC-8). An earlier update gave the start as 22:30 Pacific. Per-product mitigation times run from 02:12 to 02:38 Pacific; the 03:07 recovery is the stated incident end. Regions are the 39 regions in the page's previously affected locations list. services_n counts Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Cloud Data Fusion, Cloud Composer, Backup and DR and Memorystore; Service Networking latency is named as the cause, and header tags (Cloud Networking, Managed Airflow, Memorystore for Memcached and for Redis) are not counted separately.
